S-INTEGRATION.Purpose: Deliver FLI inside each harness through thin adapters that translate reliable harness file/lifecycle facts into Core calls and native surfaces.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Physical root: `integrations/<harness>`; one isolated subtree per harness.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Core transport: observed file path -> bundled `fli ancestors`/Core API -> native context/diagnostics.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Graph clients: file or directory anchor -> `fli graph FILE|DIR` with Core-owned boundary inference.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Agent skill transport: bundled canonical FLI skill (frostline-graph) -> native harness skill catalog.
Scope.SCP-IN-005: Lifecycle: reliable session/context identity -> Delivery reset/preserve.
Scope.SCP-IN-006: Shared shell read classification: `packages/read-classifier`, one deterministic classifier consumed by every adapter.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Integration-owned declaration parsing, selector Resolution, root detection, graph Discovery, semantic inference.

Principles.PRIN-001: The adapter owns observation, transport, lifecycle, presentation only.
Principles.PRIN-002: Exact native file-read fact over deterministic classifier over unsupported/ambiguous observation.
Principles.PRIN-003: Internal harness/package/filesystem reads are never model-visible FLI read events.
Principles.PRIN-004: Supported harnesses expose the same Core semantics; UX message meaning follows SS-ADAPTER-UX.

Requirements.REQ-001: A successful observed file read — exact native fact or shared-classifier shell read — triggers Core `ancestors` for that file; there is no `fli read` compatibility command.
Requirements.REQ-002: The integration must not inspect `.frostline`, `.git`, `HOME`, or filesystem ancestry to choose a semantic root, and must not parse `parents`/`children`.
Requirements.REQ-003: Graph viewers provide an existing anchor and consume `GraphOutput.root/focus/nodes/edges/diagnostics`; a directory anchor produces no focus; root always comes from Core; explicit root override is a user/client action only.
Requirements.REQ-004: Non-empty newly delivered context produces a model-facing injection; empty or already-delivered context produces no repetitive success noise.
Requirements.REQ-005: FLI operational failure, state warning, or integration failure produces an explicit native diagnostic.
Requirements.REQ-006: DeliveryScope derives only from reliable lifecycle identity; a missing capability is an explicit limitation, not alternate semantics.
